package com.x;
public class BWeb extends BAbstractService {
  @Override
  public final Feature getLicenseFeature() {
    return Sys.getLicenseManager().getFeature("vendor", "feature");
  }
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    render(op);
  }
  public void doPost(WebOp op) {
    write(op);
